results.evidence: Ran at 095e84e (npm ci, npm run build OK: 1041 links, 0 problems). The original reproducer redteam-RT-09-p4-m6-lengths.test.ts (from worktree-agent-a271fd128e69144b1, as an untracked copy) printed 1 passed, 2 failed. Test 1 still passes because its substring 'short roots have form value 2, long ones 4 or 6, verified by computation.' is still in the Seen item, now after 'on a board of finite type,'. Tests 2 and 3 fail by design: they assert that the engine facts are not so (form values 2, 8 on A2^(2) and 2, 4, 8 on A4^(2)), and no lesson change can alter those. By hand, the rendered Seen 2 reads '...; on a board of finite type, short roots have form value 2, long ones 4 or 6, verified by computation.' This matches SPEC 2.5. The oracle gives root form values {2} on simply laced types, {2,4} on B, C, F and {2,6} on G, for every finite type of rank 8 or less, with no exception. The fixer's content-m6-root-lengths.test.ts: 1 passed. Scratch revert of only the clause ('; on a board of finite type, short roots' back to '; short roots'): the test failed with 'M6: "short roots have form value 2, long ones 4 or 6" is stated with no restriction to the finite types; on the balanced board A2^(2) ... 2, 8, on A4^(2) 2, 4, 8: expected false to be true'. Restored from a copy taken at HEAD; cmp identical.

The original script redteam-RT-08-p4-captions.mjs now prints two captions. b11: 'One Martian in city 2 of G2, the long city; every population it reaches is a long root population, with form value ${G2_LENGTHS[1]}.' The original redteam-RT-09-p4-m7-b12-challenge.spec.ts now fails at its locator in both its test and its control.
